newsitem.title: UK: RESEARCH ALERT-BZW cuts French stocks to "neutral".
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-BZW cuts French stocks to "neutral".

text.p: French equities were cut to "neutral" from "overweight" at BZW, strategists at the brokerage said in a European equity strategy review on Wednesday.
BZW strategist John Lomax said the recent socialist election victory in France was a setback for the restructuring process, especially in the auto industry and in the financial sector.
BZW expects French company earnings growth to drop to 27 percent in 1997 from 55 percent in 1996. For 1998, BZW forecast earnings to grow by 18 percent.
Apart from France, BZW said it upgraded the Swedish and Finnish equity markets to "overweight" and raised Spain from "underweight" to "neutral".
Its least favoured markets are Italy and the UK, both rated "underweight."
